verdict.rationale: BVNK docs describe wallet-to-wallet conversion via the Transfers v3 API, rules linking fiat virtual accounts to crypto addresses, and explicit stablecoin-to-fiat and fiat-to-stablecoin rebalancing flows, plus wallet creation/management through both Portal and API. This covers the core finance-lead use case of moving value between fiat and stablecoin balances end to end. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of dashboard rebalancing workflows and a single unified end-to-end tutorial combining dashboard and API paths.
